faq.q: What is the Heroes Profile Rating and how is it calculated?
faq.a:
The HP Rating is a custom score used to rank players on the leaderboard. It is intentionally not a pure MMR ranking — a pure MMR leaderboard would quickly be dominated by smurfs and players who reach a high MMR and stop playing, making it stale and uninteresting.

Instead, HP Rating combines three factors: your MMR, your win rate, and your games played for the season — all scaled relative to other players on that leaderboard. Games played is capped relative to the top players so that spamming games alone cannot carry you to the top. The result rewards players who are actively playing, winning, and performing at a high level. You can see the exact formula by clicking "Leaderboard Requirements" on the Leaderboard page.
